name: Admin Document Title Column Resize
description: Read long document names without opening them in /panel/documents. Titles use up to two lines and expose the complete text as a native hint only when the rendered text is clipped; the same clipped-only state offers an in-place Ver completo/Contraer control in the compact card gallery. In list mode, the Título header exposes a keyboard-accessible drag separator that resizes from 240px to 520px, starts at 320px, persists the chosen width in projectapp-table-widths:documents-list, and resets on double-click. Etiquetas, Proyecto, Cliente and Fecha yield space in that order, while Estado and Acciones remain fixed and the table scrolls internally after donor floors are reached.
